profile.headline: Senior Frontend Software Engineer at HubSpot
profile.summary: Software developer with a proven history of creative problem-solving across industries. Passionate about creating beautiful, accessible web experiences. Former web development instructor, current volunteer mentor with Operation Code, a non-profit org devoted to helping veterans transition into the tech industry.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Front-End Development · Document Object Model (DOM)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Lead frontend engineer for our React/Redux/TypeScript application, guiding development and defining/adhering to best practices for the team. Serving as a primary liaison with product and UX to create a highly accessible and intuitive UI, so we that we can deliver maximum value to our busy customers.
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · Document Object Model (DOM)

positions.title: Senior Frontend Developer
positions.description: I work on a small, fast-paced team delivering beautiful, accessible web experiences for citizens and government employees. Most work is done with React, Redux, Flow, and RxJS, supporting a truly modern and performant web UI. I also occasionally contribute to our Scala backend as well as the PHP legacy code base. I've led multiple team-wide projects from tech design to completion.
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · Document Object Model (DOM)

positions.title: Instructional Manager and Software Developer
positions.description: Leading a team teaching a fast-paced full-stack web development curriculum. Students learn computer science fundamentals, Ruby on Rails, SQL, HTML/CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, React, Redux, and more.
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · Document Object Model (DOM)

positions.title: Props/Deck Crew
positions.description:
Stagehand for long-running Off-Broadway show (currently in its 25th year).
Ran nearly 1000 shows, executing carefully timed and detail-oriented stagecraft
Responsible for training and QA with new stagehands
Frequently pulled into cross-departmental projects due to broad and varied expertise (lights, video, carpentry, etc)
Created and maintained props used in various productions throughout the country

positions.title: Run Crew/Customer Service
positions.locationName: Daryl Roth Theatre, New York, NY
positions.description:
Non-traditional usher job includes various crew duties:

 Trained to perform two distinct tracks of duties during performances
 Both tracks involve moving and manipulating set pieces, directing the audience throughout the show, and performing special effects
 More traditional usher duties include greeting patrons, scanning tickets, etc. 
 Frequently placed in leadership roles and tasked with resolving emergency situations
(machine/human error, audience safety, etc.)

positions.title: Carpenter
positions.description: Building and maintaining sets for the 5-week repertory season of the MFA program at Pace University (held at Dance New Amsterdam).

volunteerExperiences.description: I provide technical and professional guidance for our diverse community of veterans, military families, and civilians as they attempt to begin or advance a career in the tech industry. I help moderate our Slack workspace and assist event planning in NYC.
